title: Xcode Build Diagnosis
purpose: Diagnose supplied sanitized build logs using cited observations, unconfirmed hypotheses and bounded proposed verification.
inputs: Sanitized supplied log with stable line numbers
Optional source excerpt and scheme/toolchain context
outputs: Structured diagnosis matching response.schema.json; no execution claims
exampleTasks: Explain an unresolved Swift symbol, missing module or incomplete build log.
knownLimitations: Log-only advice; no build, model evaluation, containment or host qualification.
Only three original synthetic fixture cases have deterministic oracles; real logs require human review.
